description: This file defines a mock class GlibWrapperMock for the IGlibWrapper interface, used for unit testing GObject/GLib related functionalities in the Rialto server component. It includes mock methods for various GLib functions and handles variadic functions via custom implementations.

classes.name: GlibWrapperMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IGlibWrapper interface for testing GLib wrapper functionalities.
